name: La Terrazza Uluwatu
where: 53MQ+VFW, Jl. Pantai Suluban Jl. Labuansait, Pecatu, Kec. Kuta Sel., Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia
why_its_here: Italian restaurant on the cliff above Suluban, started by two Italians from Pisa. Chef Lucia Nicolo works Italian tradition alongside international dishes. Tables sit at the cliff edge, so the pizza arrives with an ocean view. Breakfast through dinner, with a happy hour between.
best_for: Pizza at the cliff edge before sunset

name: Laddu Restaurant (The Sankara Suites and Villas)
where: The Sankara Suites and Villas Jalan Sri Wedari, No. 78, Ubud, Bali 80571
why_its_here: Laddu is The Sankara Suites and Villas' 24-seat restaurant above the lobby. It serves Asian-fusion food from breakfast through dinner.
best_for: A small resort dining room for an all-day Asian-fusion meal.
not_for: Large groups that need a high-capacity dining room.

name: Le Méridien Bali Jimbaran Fitness
why_its_here: The 24-hour gym at Le Méridien Bali Jimbaran, free to hotel guests, with cardio machines, exercise bikes, treadmills, free weights and weight machines. Explore Spa is on the same property.
best_for: Jimbaran guests who want a straightforward round-the-clock gym included in the room rate.

name: Lion X at Renaissance Bali Nusa Dua Resort
where: Renaissance Bali Nusa Dua Resort Kawasan Pariwisata Lot SW 4 & 5 Jl. Nusa Dua, Bali, 80363, Benoa, Kec. Kuta Sel., Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
why_its_here: Restaurant in Renaissance Bali Nusa Dua Resort Kawasan Pariwisata Lot SW 4 & 5 Jl. Nusa Dua, Nusa Dua.

name: Livingstone
where: Petitenget St No.88X, Kerobokan Kelod, Kuta Utara, Badung Regency, Bali 80361
why_its_here: Restaurant in Seminyak, open daily 7:00am-10:00pm.

name: LKP Tirtasari Spa
why_its_here: Spa in Tabanan. The published list covers Balinese Massage. Booking is by WhatsApp.
best_for: Balinese massage booked the same day.

name: Lluvia Spa
why_its_here: Spa in Seminyak. The published list covers Head Massage. Japanese Head Spa is 399K IDR for 90 minutes.
best_for: Head massage booked the same day.

name: Lola’s Cantina Mexicana — Canggu
where: Canggu Shortcut, Tibubeneng, Kuta Utara, Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia
why_its_here: Lola’s Cantina Canggu is a Mexican restaurant on the Canggu Shortcut serving tacos and cocktails.
best_for: Groups and couples choosing a casual Mexican meal in Canggu.

name: Lola’s Cantina Mexicana — Uluwatu
where: Jl. Labuansait No.10, Pecatu, Kuta Selatan, Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia
why_its_here: Lola’s Cantina Uluwatu is a Mexican restaurant in Pecatu serving tacos, cocktails and vegetarian options.
best_for: Groups and couples choosing a casual Mexican meal in Uluwatu.

name: Luigi’s Hot Pizza
where: Canggu/Batu Bolong/Berawa
why_its_here: A big, loud Neapolitan pizza joint on Jl. Batu Mejan built out of shipping containers, with a Napoli-imported wood-fired oven and weekly party nights. Pizza and good times are the whole point.
best_for: Pizza, drinks and a party from 4pm, in a shipping-container room on Batu Mejan.
not_for: Breakfast or lunch — it opens at 4pm daily.

name: Luna & Sol Pilates - Yoga
why_its_here: Pilates studio on Jl. Raya Semat. Classes run on equipment - reformer, chair and springboard - alongside mat and yoga. Mixed beginner and intermediate levels. Some classes also run on Zoom.
best_for: Equipment pilates rather than mat work

name: LuxMe Bali
why_its_here: Spa in Jimbaran. The published list covers Four Hands Massage.
best_for: Four hands massage booked the same day.

name: Luxury Spa
why_its_here: Day spa in Nusa Dua. The published list covers Pilates. Booking is on the venue's own site.
best_for: Pilates booked the same day.

name: Mû Boutique Resort
why_its_here: Resort spa in the Bukit. The published list covers Yoga. Booking is on the venue's own site.
best_for: Yoga booked the same day.

name: Mandapa Fitness Centre
why_its_here: The 24-hour fitness centre at Mandapa, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve, in the Ayung river valley near Ubud, free to use for resort guests. It sits alongside the Mandapa Spa & Wellness Centre, whose yoga classes run in a river-facing pavilion and on platforms set over the rice terraces.
best_for: Guests staying in the Ubud river valley who want a round-the-clock gym plus yoga in the paddy-field pavilions.

name: Mantra Wellness Bali
why_its_here: Wellness spa in the Bukit. The published list covers Balinese Massage, Yoga and Traditional Massage. Booking is on the venue's own site.
best_for: Balinese massage booked the same day.

name: Mapogu Coffee & Eatery Mapogu Restaurant
where: Jl. Goa Gong No.88x, Jimbaran, Kec. Kuta Sel., Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia
why_its_here: Cafe and coworking space in Goa Gong, Jimbaran, open since 2022. Korean-leaning dishes alongside Indonesian and international plates. Free wifi, parking, and live music at weekends.
best_for: A work day in Jimbaran with lunch on site
not_for: A Sunday visit - the kitchen is closed that day

name: Massimo — Italian Restaurant
where: Sanur
why_its_here: A long-running Italian restaurant on Sanur's main Jalan Danau Tamblingan strip, making pasta, mozzarella/burrata and gelato in-house daily, with wood-fired naturally-leavened pizza. The owner has produced Italian gelato in Sanur since 1996, with 48+ flavours.
best_for: families and groups wanting familiar Italian food; a casual sit-down dinner on the main street; a dedicated gelato stop
not_for: anyone wanting beachfront or sea-view seating (it is on the street, not the shore)

name: Maya Sanur Fitness Centre
why_its_here: The air-conditioned fitness centre at Maya Sanur Resort & Spa, free to use for in-house guests, fitted with cardio and strength machines. It sits on a beachfront property with the resort's long lagoon pool and four restaurants.
best_for: Sanur guests who want an air-conditioned gym at no extra charge, a few steps from the beach.

name: Maya Ubud Fitness Centre
where: Peliatan / Ubud edge
why_its_here: The fitness centre at Maya Ubud Resort & Spa on the Peliatan ridge, overlooking the Petanu river valley.
best_for: Maya Ubud guests who want a workout with a valley view.

name: Maya Ubud Yoga
where: Peliatan / Ubud edge
why_its_here: Yoga at Maya Ubud Resort & Spa, held in a shala overlooking the Petanu valley.
best_for: Maya Ubud guests wanting a scenic class as part of a spa stay.

name: Melons
why_its_here: Restaurant in Nusa Dua. The kitchen is described as International. The published menu includes Vietnamese Rice Paper Roll, Thai Vegetable Spring Rolls and Beef Carpaccio. Booking is on the venue's own site.
best_for: International in Nusa Dua.

name: Menega Cafe
where: Muaya Beach (Pantai Muaya), Jimbaran, Kec. Kuta Selatan, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
why_its_here: A long-running Jimbaran Bay seafood cafe where you pick fresh seafood by weight from the display and it is grilled over coconut-husk fires. Tables sit directly on Muaya Beach for toes-in-the-sand dining at sunset.
best_for: beachfront seafood dinner; sunset over the bay; groups sharing a seafood spread; special evening out
not_for: budget quick bites; vegetarians seeking variety; anyone wanting a quiet or air-conditioned room

name: menjamu
why_its_here: Restaurant in Seminyak. The kitchen is described as Indonesian Cuisine. The published menu includes Chicken Soto, Rawon Beef and Oxtail. Booking is on the venue's own site.
best_for: Indonesian Cuisine in Seminyak.

name: Mercure Bali Sanur Resort
why_its_here: Wellness spa in Sanur. The published list covers Reflexology and Traditional Massage. Reflexology Treatment is 299K IDR for 45 minutes. Booking is on the venue's own site.
best_for: Tired feet after a day of walking.

name: Milk & Madu Seminyak
where: Jl. Raya Seminyak No.56, Seminyak, Kuta, Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia
why_its_here: Milk & Madu Seminyak is a family-friendly all-day café on Jalan Raya Seminyak serving breakfast, brunch, pizza and international dishes.
best_for: Families and groups choosing an easy café meal in central Seminyak.

name: Milk & Madu Uluwatu
where: Jalan Labuan Sait, Banjar Dinas Labuan Sait, Pecatu, Kuta Selatan, Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia
why_its_here: Milk & Madu Uluwatu is a family-friendly all-day café in Pecatu serving breakfast, brunch, pizza and international dishes.
best_for: Families and groups choosing an easy all-day meal in Uluwatu.

name: MOONLITE KITCHEN & BAR
where: Jl Camplung Tanduk Dhyana Pura, Seminyak Beach, Seminyak, Bali 80361
why_its_here: Rooftop bar and restaurant on top of Anantara Seminyak Bali Resort, serving modern Southeast Asian dishes with ocean views. Nightly live bands and DJ sets give it an energetic, dressed-up evening feel.
best_for: couples wanting a rooftop dinner with a view; travellers after cocktails at golden hour; a lively night out with music
not_for: anyone wanting a quiet, low-key meal (live music/DJ most nights)

name: Mori Ubud
where: Jalan Bisma No.68, Ubud, Gianyar 80571
why_its_here: Japanese fine dining and teppanyaki in central Ubud, with local produce and Japanese proteins.
best_for: Special-occasion diners choosing Japanese fine dining in Ubud.
not_for: Budget diners or people seeking a quick daytime meal.

name: Motion Skatepark
why_its_here: Indoor skatepark on Sunset Road, rebuilt in 2019. Street-style layout with transitions around the perimeter and a mini ramp to one side, obstacles from easy to hard. There is a skate shop on site, and locals will teach if asked.
best_for: Skating out of the rain or the midday heat

name: Mövenpick Jimbaran Yoga
why_its_here: Yoga at Mövenpick Resort & Spa Jimbaran, run through the resort's 24-hour fitness centre in the Samasta complex. Some classes are free, including the Sunday vinyasa session; others are charged. Pilates runs on the same timetable.
best_for: Guests who want to try a class without paying, starting with the free Sunday vinyasa.

name: Mövenpick Resort & Spa Jimbaran Fitness
why_its_here: The 24-hour gym at Mövenpick Resort & Spa Jimbaran, stocked with current cardio machines and weight stations. A class programme runs alongside it covering yoga, pilates, aqua aerobics and water volleyball, and cycling is available on the property.
best_for: Jimbaran guests who want round-the-clock machines plus a scheduled class list including pool-based sessions.

name: Mozzarella Restaurant at The Magani Hotel and Spa
where: The Magani Lantai 2 Jalan Melasti Legian Kelod, Legian, Kec. Kuta, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
why_its_here: Restaurant in The Magani Lantai 2 Jalan Melasti Legian Kelod, Kuta Legian, open daily 7:00am-11:00pm.

name: myCHEF
why_its_here: Restaurant in Canggu. The kitchen is described as Private Dining, Fine Dining. Wine Pairing is 850K IDR. Booking is by WhatsApp.
best_for: A special-occasion dinner, not a quick casual meal.
not_for: A cheap casual meal — the menu starts at 850K IDR.

name: Nagisa Japanese Restaurant at Hotel Nikko Bali Benoa Beach
where: Hotel Nikko Bali Benoa Beach Jalan Pratama No.68X Tanjung Benoa, Nusa Dua, South Kuta, Badung Regency, Bali 80363
why_its_here: Restaurant in Nusa Dua, open daily 12:00-10:00pm.

name: Nampu Japanese Restaurant at Grand Hyatt Bali
where: Grand Hyatt Bali Lobby, Benoa, South Kuta, Badung Regency, Bali 80363
why_its_here: Restaurant in Grand Hyatt Bali Lobby, Nusa Dua.

name: NARI - Fire Influenced Bistro
where: Jl. Raya Campuhan, Sayan, Kecamatan Ubud, Kabupaten Gianyar, Bali 80571
why_its_here: NARI cooks a contemporary bistro menu over wood fire in Sayan. The dining room overlooks Campuhan Ridge and Gunung Lebah Temple. Its menu moves from flatbreads and pasta to charcoal-grilled fish and chicken.
best_for: A wood-fire lunch or dinner with a Campuhan Ridge outlook.
not_for: Diners seeking a low-cost warung meal.

name: Natys Bar & Grill Ubud
where: Ubud, Gianyar Regency, Bali 80571
why_its_here: Restaurant in Ubud, open daily 7:00am-11:00pm.

name: NAYA Uluwatu
why_its_here: Semi-private pilates studio in Bingin, Uluwatu. Five reformers per class, so the format stays small and precise.
best_for: A near-private reformer class

name: Nirvana Life Bali
where: Berawa / Canggu
why_its_here: A Berawa fitness-and-wellness club open 6am–11pm, combining gym, classes and recovery under one roof.
best_for: Canggu stayers who want long hours and a mix of training and recovery.

name: NOONIK Bistro
where: Jl. Raya Pengosekan No.1, Mas, Kecamatan Ubud, Kabupaten Gianyar, Bali 80571
why_its_here: NOONIK is a modern Asian bistro in Mas, Ubud. Its all-day menu spans breakfast through dinner with Asian and Indonesian dishes. It opens daily from 07:00 to 22:30.
best_for: An all-day Asian meal in Mas, from breakfast through dinner.
not_for: A fixed-course dinner centred on one cuisine or one service window.

name: Nui da Mano - Beachfront Restaurant in Batu Belig
where: Pantai Jl. Batu Belig, Kerobokan Kelod, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
why_its_here: Nui da Mano is a Polynesian-inspired restaurant directly on Batu Belig Beach. Its menu reinterprets Polynesian flavours with local ingredients. The open-air setting is arranged around shared plates by the sea.
best_for: Beachfront sharing plates by the sea in Batu Belig.
not_for: Diners seeking a strictly traditional, single-island Polynesian menu.

name: Nusa Dua Beach Hotel Yoga
why_its_here: Daily yoga from 07:00 to 08:00 at the Yoga Bale at Nusa Dua Beach Hotel & Spa in the ITDC estate. Classes also run on the beach and in the landscaped gardens, and the property has a fitness centre, several pools, volleyball and squash.
best_for: ITDC-estate guests who want a fixed morning class slot with a garden or beach setting.

name: Olop Iyengar Yoga
why_its_here: A dedicated Iyengar-yoga studio in Seminyak focused on alignment and props-based practice.
best_for: Practitioners who specifically want precise, Iyengar-method classes.

name: Oma Jamu
where: Canggu/Berawa
why_its_here: A budget vegan cafe and organic grocery near Batu Bolong's Puseh temple, serving all-day plant-based Indonesian food, cold-pressed juices, kombucha and traditional jamu tonics.
best_for: Affordable vegan and vegetarian eating, healthy breakfasts and jamu in a calm daytime setting.
not_for: Not for diners wanting meat or a full-service dinner.

name: Padang Padang Surf Camp
why_its_here: A Bingin-based surf coaching operation running since 2005, led by a coach who grew up surfing Bingin.
best_for: structured surf coaching for progressing surfers at Bingin

name: Padma Resort Legian
why_its_here: Day spa in Legian. The published list covers Hair Treatment. Booking is on the venue's own site.
best_for: Hair treatment booked the same day.
not_for: A budget massage — the list starts at 770K IDR.

name: PAK GULA
where: Jl. Pantai Bingin No.05, Pecatu, Kec. Kuta Sel., Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia
why_its_here: Two-storey restaurant in Bingin from the team behind The Cashew Tree. Sharing plates: char siu pork bao, vegetable dumplings, chicken satay, braised beef curry. The ground floor is casual; upstairs is a dinner room with low light, communal tables and a bar.
best_for: A shared dinner in Bingin
not_for: Walking in at dinner - booking is recommended

name: Pala Spa
why_its_here: Wellness spa in Munduk. The published list covers Balinese Massage. Booking is on the venue's own site.
best_for: Balinese massage booked the same day.

name: Pantai Lovina
why_its_here: A black-sand beach on Bali's north coast, Buleleng, the base for early-morning dolphin-watching boat trips.
best_for: a dawn dolphin-watching boat trip; a quieter north-Bali beach base

name: Pantai Pandawa
why_its_here: A white-sand beach on the Bukit peninsula, Badung, reached by a road cut through the cliffs, with statues of the Pandawa brothers lining the entrance.
best_for: calmer water than the west-coast surf beaches; families and swimmers

name: Paoman Restaurant at Inara Alas Harum
where: H7G9+R9M Jalan Raya Bresela Kecamatan Payangan, Taro, Kecamatan Ubud, Kabupaten Gianyar, Bali 80572
why_its_here: Restaurant in H7G9+R9M Jalan Raya Bresela Kecamatan Payangan, Ubud.

name: Paradise Padel Bali
why_its_here: Padel club on Jalan Subak Sari. Equipment rental, parking, a shop, restaurant and changing rooms. Courts book through Playtomic, and a 60-minute session with a coach starts at 900,000 IDR. Tournaments and mixed-level sessions run regularly.
best_for: Padel booked from the phone

name: Parigata Resorts and Spa - Sanur Bali
why_its_here: Spa in Sanur. The published list covers Balinese Massage and Spa Package. Booking is on the venue's own site.
best_for: A long reset — treatments run up to 120 minutes.

name: Piasan Nusa Dua Restaurant Piasan Restaurant
where: BTDC Area, Jl. Nusa Dua, Benoa, Kec. Kuta Sel., Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia
why_its_here: Italian restaurant in the BTDC area of Nusa Dua, at Kayumanis. The dining room is built from over 15,000 bamboo stems, with floating partitions and a raised ceiling. The name comes from a Balinese term for a ceremonial structure.
best_for: An Italian dinner in Nusa Dua

name: Pica South American Kitchen
where: Jl. Dewisita No.2C, Ubud, Gianyar 80571
why_its_here: A small South American kitchen in central Ubud with a distinctive cuisine angle absent from most local lists.
best_for: Diners seeking Peruvian and South American flavours in Ubud.
not_for: People looking for Balinese food or a large family room.

name: Pizzaria (Hyatt)
where: Sanur
why_its_here: The Italian beachfront restaurant and bar at Hyatt Regency Bali, on Sanur Beach, serving antipasti, wood-fired sourdough pizza, pasta, seafood and meat with sea views. Lunch and dinner daily, plus a Sunday Brunch with live grills and carvings.
best_for: couples wanting an upscale beachfront resort dinner; a special-occasion meal; Sunday brunch with a group; families dining early at the resort
not_for: anyone after a quick, budget, casual street meal

name: Plantation Restaurant at Alila Ubud
where: Melinggih Kelod, Ubud, Gianyar Regency, Bali 80572
why_its_here: Restaurant in Melinggih Kelod, Ubud.

name: Poggy Bali Surf School
why_its_here: A surf school based at Padang Padang beach coaching all levels across the Bukit's breaks -- Padang Padang, Bingin, Dreamland and others.
best_for: tailored surf coaching across the Bukit's breaks

name: Pole Studio Bali
why_its_here: Pole studio in Seminyak. Beginner classes cover spins, climbs and transitions; intermediate and advanced work through routines. Flexibility and conditioning classes run alongside, and private lessons are available.
best_for: Starting pole from zero

name: Prego at The Westin Resort Nusa Dua, Bali
where: Kawasan Pariwisata Nusa Dua BTDC Lot N-3, Nusa Dua, Kuta Selatan, Benoa, South Kuta, Badung Regency, Bali 80363
why_its_here: Restaurant in Kawasan Pariwisata Nusa Dua BTDC Lot N-3, Nusa Dua, open daily 12:00-10:00pm.

name: Prime Plaza Hotel Sanur Fitness Centre
why_its_here: The fitness centre at Prime Plaza Hotel Sanur, open to the public as well as hotel guests. It carries treadmills, stationary bikes, dumbbells, free weights, weight machines and cardio and resistance kit, with a changing room, hot and cold showers and lockers. Guests train free; walk-ins pay 100,000 IDR at peak and 75,000 IDR off peak, which includes locker, shower and spa access. Personal trainers can be booked ahead by the hour, day or week. The property also has a hot tub, a sauna, eight spa treatment rooms and a 110-metre free-form pool.
best_for: Anyone in Sanur wanting a well-equipped gym on a cheap walk-in basis, with sauna and hot tub included in the entry price.

name: Pullman Bali Legian Beach
why_its_here: Resort spa in Legian. The published list covers Traditional Massage. Booking is on the venue's own site.
best_for: Traditional massage booked the same day.

name: Queen's of India at Nusa Dua
where: Tanjung Jl. Pratama No.65 B, Benoa, Kec. Kuta Sel., Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
why_its_here: Restaurant in Nusa Dua, open daily 12:00-11:30pm.

name: Reform Pilates Bingin
why_its_here: The first reformer pilates studio in Bingin, opened in 2023 by Abbey. Classes include Booty & Core, Body Blast and deep stretch. Pre- and post-natal reformer classes run for the first and second trimesters. Booking is online.
best_for: Reformer work close to Bingin beach

name: Reform+ Uluwatu
why_its_here: Reform+ is the second Reform Pilates location, in Uluwatu. Reformer classes with online booking.
best_for: Reformer pilates in Uluwatu

name: Rempah Restaurant (Menzel Ubud)
where: Menzel Ubud, Banjar Kalah Peliatan, Ubud, Bali 80571
why_its_here: Restaurant in Menzel Ubud, Ubud.

name: Retro Kitchen and Bar
where: Sanur
why_its_here: Broad-menu kitchen-and-bar on the main Sanur strip mixing Australian steaks, Western favourites and Indonesian dishes, with a dedicated kids' section.
best_for: families with kids; groups wanting varied Western-and-local options in one place

name: Rip Curl School of Surf
why_its_here: Surf school on Sanur beach inside the Prama Sanur Beach hotel, running since 1998. Surfing, kitesurfing, stand-up paddle, windsurfing, wakeboarding, diving and foiling, with certification and rentals. The Little Ripper programme is for under-13s.
best_for: Children learning to surf on a gentle break

name: River Warung at Bambu Indah
where: Sayan, Ubud, Gianyar Regency, Bali 80571
why_its_here: Restaurant in Sayan, Ubud, open daily 7:30am-9:30pm.

name: Rockfish Cliffside
where: Br. Dinas Karang Boma, Jl. Batu Bolong, Pecatu, Kuta Selatan, Badung, Bali, Indonesia
why_its_here: Rockfish Cliffside is an owner-confirmed cliffside restaurant in Pecatu serving seafood and wagyu-led dishes.
best_for: Travellers planning a cliffside dinner in Uluwatu.

name: Rokkyu Teppanyaki (Grand Istana Rama Hotel Kuta)
where: Grand Istana Rama Hotel Kuta Jalan Pantai Kuta, Kuta, Bali 80361
why_its_here: Rokkyu Teppanyaki is a Japanese restaurant at Grand Istana Rama Hotel in Kuta. The Chef Table is built around live teppanyaki cooking. Rice bowls and à la carte dishes are served in the regular dining area. It opens daily from 12:00 to 23:00.
best_for: Lunch or dinner with live teppanyaki cooking in Kuta.
not_for: Breakfast or an early-morning meal.

name: Roots
where: Jl. Pantai Pererenan No.121, Pererenan, Kec. Mengwi, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80351
why_its_here: An all-day plant-based restaurant in Pererenan built around a customizable build-your-own-bowl with 50+ ingredients, plus bold drinks, serving vegans, vegetarians and anyone eating less meat.
best_for: Plant-based and health-focused eaters, a customizable brunch or bowl, and casual laptop-friendly daytime sitting.
not_for: Meat-centric diners or a formal special-occasion dinner.

name: Rosehill Spa
why_its_here: Day spa in Nusa Dua. The published list covers Traditional Massage and Reflexology. Foot Reflexology is 300K IDR for 60 minutes. Booking is on the venue's own site.
best_for: Tired feet after a day of walking.

name: Rotisserie by Cashew Tree
where: Jl. Bangbang Metuug No.3, Pecatu, Kec. Kuta Sel., Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia
why_its_here: Rotisserie from The Cashew Tree in Pecatu. Slow-roasted meats with fresh sides and sauces.
best_for: A plate of roast meat after the beach

name: S2S Crossfit
why_its_here: CrossFit box on Jl. Raya Semat, the first CrossFit affiliate on the island. CrossFit, weightlifting, high-intensity cardio and personal training. A drop-in is 200,000 IDR and needs no booking - arrive ten minutes before class.
best_for: A drop-in WOD without booking ahead

name: Santai Beach House
why_its_here: Restaurant in Nusa Dua. The kitchen is described as International with local inspiration. The published menu includes Hummus, Grilled Calamari and Tuna Crudo. Booking is by WhatsApp.
best_for: International with local inspiration in Nusa Dua.

name: Sanur Surf School
why_its_here: Surf school in Sanur teaching at Baby Reef, a short boat ride offshore where the waves break smaller and softer than in the south. Private lessons and semi-private for two, from a first wave to refining technique. Children are welcome and foiling is taught as well.
best_for: A first surf lesson on a forgiving break

name: Seabird Bistro & Coworking Canggu by Wonderspace
where: Jl. Nelayan No.888B, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia
why_its_here: Bistro and coworking space on Jl. Nelayan, part of the Wonderspace group. Italian comfort food with a French turn: grilled lobster tagliatelle, wagyu steak frites, rigatoni vodka. Vegetarian and vegan options, local wines and cocktails.
best_for: A working morning that turns into lunch

name: Seasalt
where: Seminyak / seminyak
why_its_here: Beachfront seafood-led fine dining inside Alila, strongest for coastal date nights and brunch splurges.
best_for: date night special; sunset drinks view; special occasion

name: Serenity Bali Yogi Spa
why_its_here: Spa in Canggu. The published list covers Balinese Massage. Balinese Massage is 250K IDR for 60 minutes. Booking runs through Fresha.
best_for: Balinese massage booked the same day.

name: Serenity Eco Guesthouse & Yoga
where: Nelayan / Canggu
why_its_here: The long-running yoga shala at Serenity Eco Guesthouse in Nelayan, with a busy daily timetable and a wellness day pass (249k).
best_for: Budget-minded yogis who want plentiful daily classes in a friendly eco setting.

name: Seven Paintings Ubud Restaurant
where: Jl. Bisma No.888A, Ubud, Kecamatan Ubud, Kabupaten Gianyar, Bali 80571, Indonesia
why_its_here: A seven-course dinner staged as a show. Each course is matched to an artist, from Michelangelo to Van Gogh, against 3D projections. Sixteen seats a session, Tuesday to Sunday. Doors at 18:00, the show starts at 19:00.
best_for: A booked-ahead dinner for an occasion
not_for: Children under six and walk-ins - seats are booked ahead

name: SISTA DUMPLING 喜食
where: Jl. Raya Semat No.7, Tibubeneng, Kabupaten Badung
why_its_here: Sista Dumpling is a modern dumpling bistro on Jl. Raya Semat in Berawa, built around sharing plates and drinks, open from late morning to 11pm. There is a second branch in Uluwatu; everything recorded here is the Berawa room.
best_for: A dumpling bistro in Berawa built for sharing, open from late morning.
not_for: A late booking — last reservation is 10pm, taken two hours ahead.

name: Six Senses Uluwatu Pilates
why_its_here: Pilates at Six Senses Uluwatu runs in the same air-conditioned pavilion as the resort yoga and Pranayama programme, on the clifftop grounds above Pecatu.
best_for: Resort guests who want a mat-based session alongside the yoga schedule rather than a standalone studio.

name: S.K.A.I Beach Club
why_its_here: A beach club at Padma Resort Legian with a semi-alfresco terrace and an infinity pool set over the Legian surf, built around sunset.
best_for: sunset over an infinity pool in Legian

name: Spa at RIMBA by AYANA Bali
where: AYANA estate / Jimbaran ridge
why_its_here: The spa at RIMBA by AYANA on the vast AYANA estate above Jimbaran, one of Bali's largest resort-and-wellness complexes.
best_for: RIMBA and AYANA guests wanting resort treatments with access to the wider estate.

name: Spa Sidemen
why_its_here: Massage studio in Sidemen. The published list covers Balinese Massage. Balinese Massage is 250K IDR for 60 minutes. Booking is by WhatsApp.
best_for: A long reset — treatments run up to 120 minutes.

name: St. Regis Bali Yoga
why_its_here: The yoga and movement programme at The St. Regis Bali Resort, run from a dedicated yoga room inside the Iridium Spa. A complimentary schedule covers beachside yoga, stand-up paddle yoga, meditation and Tai Chi sessions in the resort amphitheatre.
best_for: Guests who want a free daily practice on the beach or on the water, not just a mat in a hotel gym.

name: Sundara
why_its_here: Restaurant in Jimbaran. The kitchen is described as modern Indonesian. The published menu includes Wagyu Beef Tartare, Coffee Wood-Smoked Salmon and Coconut Crab Salad. Booking is on the venue's own site.
best_for: Modern Indonesian in Jimbaran.

name: Sunset Pilates Legian
why_its_here: A Legian pilates studio with scheduled classes you can drop into -- a lower-impact alternative to yoga for a morning session near the beach.
best_for: a drop-in pilates class in Legian

name: Svaha Spa Melasti
why_its_here: Day spa in the Bukit. The published list covers Balinese Massage and Spa Package. Booking is on the venue's own site.
best_for: Balinese massage booked the same day.

name: Swan Restaurant Keramas (Desa Swan Villas and Spa)
where: Desa Swan Villas and Spa Jalan Pantai Selukat, Keramas Beach, Gianyar, Bali 80581
why_its_here: Restaurant in Desa Swan Villas and Spa Jalan Pantai Selukat, Ubud.

name: T'dung Restaurant Pool and Bar at Kenran Resort Ubud
where: Kenderan, Tegallalang, Gianyar, Bali 80552, Kenderan, Tegallalang, Gianyar Regency, Bali 80522
why_its_here: Restaurant in Kenderan, Ubud, open daily 7:00am-10:30pm.

name: Takir Restaurant and Bar (Arya Arkananta Resort and Spa)
where: Arya Arkananta Resort and Spa, Gang Damai Sayan, Ubud, Bali 80571
why_its_here: Cafe in Arya Arkananta Resort and Spa, Ubud.

name: TAKK Bali
where: Jl. Petitenget No.12b, Kerobokan Kelod, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
why_its_here: TAKK is a casual fine-dining restaurant on Jalan Petitenget. Its dinner menu uses Bali ingredients in refined plates. Listed signatures include sea-salt cured salmon, charred local lamb and a cocoa-and-citrus dessert.
best_for: An intimate Wednesday-to-Sunday fine-dining dinner in Petitenget.
not_for: Daytime meals or Monday-to-Tuesday dinner plans.

name: Takumi Bali
where: Jl. Petitenget No.43A, Seminyak, Bali
why_its_here: Contemporary Japanese fine dining on Jl. Petitenget, set behind a Japanese garden. Chef Daijiro Horikoshi builds tasting menus from local and imported produce by season. An 18-course omakase runs Friday and Saturday at 19:00; kaiseki comes in nine and six courses, with a vegan version. Upstairs the Nikai bar holds limited sake, Japanese whisky and wine.
best_for: A tasting menu booked for an occasion
not_for: Lunch or an early dinner - service starts at 18:00

name: Tanah Liat (Renaissance Bali Nusa Dua Resort)
where: Renaissance Bali Nusa Dua Resort, Kawasan Pariwisata Lot SW 4 - 5, Nusa Dua, Bali 80361
why_its_here: Restaurant in Renaissance Bali Nusa Dua Resort, Nusa Dua.

name: Tanah Lot
why_its_here: Bali's most photographed sea temple, on an offshore rock framed by the sunset. The inner sanctum is closed to non-worshippers; the rock base is reachable only at low tide.
best_for: sunset photography; a short coastal walk timed to low tide

name: The Cave Restaurant
why_its_here: Restaurant in the Bukit. The kitchen is described as Modern gastronomy. The published menu includes High Tea, Dinner and In-Villa Dining.
best_for: Modern gastronomy in the Bukit.

name: The Chowk - Indian Gourmet House. (Museum Puri Lukisan Ubud)
where: Museum Puri Lukisan, Jl. Raya Ubud No.29, Ubud, Gianyar Regency, Bali 80571
why_its_here: The Chowk Indian Gourmet House is an Indian restaurant at Museum Puri Lukisan in central Ubud.
best_for: Vegetarian and non-vegetarian diners choosing Indian food in central Ubud.

name: The Coffee Club Legian at Anantara Vacation Club
where: The Coffee Club Jl. Pantai Arjuna, Gg. Blue Ocean Beach No.18, Legian, Kec. Kuta, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
why_its_here: Restaurant on Gg. Blue Ocean Beach No.18 in Kuta Legian, open daily 6:00am-10:00pm.

name: The Free Bird Studio
why_its_here: Movement studio in Berawa. The programme runs to movement, healing, ceremony and activation.
best_for: Movement work rather than a gym floor

name: The Garcia Ubud
why_its_here: Spa in Ubud. The published list covers Balinese Massage. Traditional Balinese Massage is 690K IDR. Booking is on the venue's own site.
best_for: Balinese massage booked the same day.
not_for: A budget massage — the list starts at 690K IDR.

name: The Jungle Club Ubud by Wonderspace
where: Jl. Jaga Raga No.8A, Celuk, Ubud, Gianyar Regency, Bali 80582, Indonesia
why_its_here: Adults-only day club on roughly two hectares of jungle in Celuk. An infinity pool, a jungle deck, a boho cave and a jetty. Svaha Spa sits on the same grounds. Live music and themed events.
best_for: A day by a pool without leaving the jungle
not_for: Families - the club is adults-only

name: The Kelusa at Samsara Ubud
where: Banjar Ayah No.Desa, Kelusa, Payangan, Gianyar Regency, Bali 80572
why_its_here: Restaurant in Ubud, open daily 7:00am-11:00pm.

name: The Little Hill Terrace
where: Dusun Munduk Langki, The restaurant located inside The Little Hill Suites, Munduk, Kec. Banjar, Kabupaten Buleleng, Bali 81152, Indonesia
why_its_here: Restaurant inside The Little Hill Suites in Munduk. Locally sourced cooking from the farms of North Bali. The terrace looks over green hills and valleys.
best_for: A mountain lunch on the way through Munduk

name: The Northview Bali – Ngiring Ngewedang Restaurant & Coffee Corner
where: Tamblingan, Munduk Buleleng, Kec. Banjar, Bali, 81152, Indonesia
why_its_here: Restaurant and coffee corner on a hilltop in Munduk village. Asian and Indonesian dishes with Balinese coffee and teas. Crispy duck and banana fritters are regulars. The open dining room faces the hills and valleys.
best_for: Coffee and a sunset over the Munduk hills
not_for: A quick stop - it is three hours from the airport

name: The ONE Legian Hotel
why_its_here: Restaurant in Legian. The kitchen is described as Urban Street Food, Asian, Western, International. The published menu includes Western Menu Promotion, Indonesian Menu Promotion and Light Bite Food. Booking is on the venue's own site.
best_for: Urban Street Food, Asian, Western, International in Legian.

name: The Sanur
why_its_here: Day spa in Sanur. The published list covers Balinese Massage and Aromatherapy. Balinese Massage is 350K IDR for 60 minutes. Booking is on the venue's own site.
best_for: Balinese massage booked the same day.

name: The Tanjung Benoa Beach Resort
why_its_here: Resort spa in Nusa Dua. The published list covers Balinese Massage, Aromatherapy and Facial. Balinese Massage is 450K IDR for 60 minutes.
best_for: Balinese massage booked the same day.

name: The Ungasan
why_its_here: Wellness spa in the Bukit. The published list covers Facial. Booking is by WhatsApp.
best_for: Facial booked the same day.

name: Think Pink Nails Canggu
where: Canggu
why_its_here: A Canggu branch of Think Pink, doing manicures, pedicures and playful nail art at friendly prices.
best_for: A quick, well-priced mani-pedi between beach and café.

name: This Is Bali
why_its_here: Restaurant in Ubud. The kitchen is described as Balinese Food & Desserts. The published menu includes Crunchy Chicken Spring Rolls, Crunchy Veggie Spring Rolls and Bali Summer Rolls. Booking is on the venue's own site.
best_for: Balinese Food & Desserts in Ubud.

name: Tirta Empul
why_its_here: A temple built around a sacred spring where Balinese Hindus, and visitors, perform melukat, a purification ritual moving spout to spout through the bathing pool. A sarong is required and provided at the gate.
best_for: the melukat purification ritual; a culturally rich half-day near Ubud

name: Tirta Padma (Tribhuwana Padma)
where: Tribhuwana Padma, Jalan Kedisan No. 28, Kintamani, Bali 80652
why_its_here: Tirta Padma is the dining outlet at Tribhuwana Padma in Kedisan, Kintamani. The resort's lakeside setting frames the meal around Mount Batur and the surrounding highland landscape.
best_for: A lakeside meal during a planned Kintamani visit.
not_for: A quick meal during a tightly timed south-Bali beach itinerary.

name: Titi Batu Ubud Club
why_its_here: A large sports-and-social club near Nyuh Kuning with gym, pool, courts and a café, open 8am–10pm daily.
best_for: Families and long-stayers who want a full day-club rather than just a gym.

name: Tonic
why_its_here: Wellness spa in Legian. The published list covers Aromatherapy and Couple Massage. Couples Spa Package is 750K IDR for 90 minutes. Booking is on the venue's own site.
best_for: Couples — the list includes a couple treatment.

name: Tsune Japanese Restaurant Sanur by Wonderspace
where: Jl. Aruna No.8A, Sanur Kaja, Denpasar Selatan, Denpasar City, Bali 80237, Indonesia
why_its_here: Japanese restaurant in Sanur with Indonesia's first floating sushi: plates travel to the table along a waterway. A Japanese fish grill runs alongside. Live music on Saturday evenings, and 10% off lunch every day.
best_for: A sushi dinner that doubles as a show

name: Ubud Bodyworks Centre
why_its_here: Wellness spa in Ubud. The published list covers Deep Tissue. Booking is by WhatsApp.
best_for: Deep tissue booked the same day.
not_for: A budget massage — the list starts at 750K IDR.

name: Ubud Fitness Center
where: Ubud
why_its_here: A local gym in central Ubud with weights, cardio and classes.
best_for: Ubud stayers who want a straightforward gym rather than a hotel fitness room.

name: Ubud Yoga Centre
where: Jl. Raya Singakerta No. 108, Nyuh Kuning, Ubud, Gianyar 80571
why_its_here: A contemporary two-tier complex on the edge of Nyuh Kuning, best known as Ubud's dedicated hot-yoga studio, with a gong centre, kids centre and cafe.
best_for: Practitioners specifically after a heated practice (Bikram/hot Ashtanga) and families wanting a kids programme.
not_for: Anyone who dislikes heat or prefers gentle, cool-room classes.

name: Uma Garden
why_its_here: Restaurant in Canggu. The kitchen is described as wood-fire. The published menu includes Wood-fire steaks, Pasta and Seafood. Booking is on the venue's own site.
best_for: Wood-fire in Canggu.

name: Urban Seaside restaurant & bar
where: Jalan segara samuh, Lingkungan banjar celuk Jl. Nusa Dua, Benoa, Kec. Kuta Sel., Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80363
why_its_here: Urban Seaside is a beachfront restaurant on Jalan Segara Samuh in Nusa Dua. Its menu combines daily fresh catch, international comfort dishes and Asian-influenced flavours. It opens daily from 08:00 to 23:00.
best_for: A casual beachfront lunch or dinner in Nusa Dua.
not_for: A tightly timed day when travelling to Nusa Dua would add a long detour.

name: Usadha Spa
why_its_here: Spa in Legian. The published list covers Balinese Massage. Booking is on the venue's own site.
best_for: Balinese massage booked the same day.

name: Wajik Restaurant by Ely's Kitchen (Unagi Wooden Villas by Emana)
where: Unagi Wooden Villas by Emana, Br. Apuh, Lodtunduh, Ubud, Bali 80571
why_its_here: Cafe in Unagi Wooden Villas by Emana, Ubud.

name: Waka Bar and Restaurant (WakaGangga Boutique Resort)
where: WakaGangga Boutique Resort Jalan Pantai Yeh Gangga, Sudimara, Tabanan, Bali 82115
why_its_here: Restaurant in WakaGangga Boutique Resort Jalan Pantai Yeh Gangga, Tabanan.

name: Warnakali Restaurant at Adiwana Warnakali Resort
where: Sakti, Regency, Klungkung Regency, Bali 80771
why_its_here: Restaurant in Sakti, Nusa Islands, open daily 7:00am-11:00pm.

name: Warung Bu Mi
where: Canggu/Batu Bolong/Berawa
why_its_here: Warung Bu Mi serves Indonesian home-style food in Batu Bolong. Its official profile states that all food is halal and lists service from 09:00 to 22:00.
best_for: An Indonesian home-style meal in Batu Bolong.
not_for: A formal multi-course dinner or a special-occasion restaurant setting.

name: Warung Jawa Bu Sri
why_its_here: A small family-run Javanese-Balinese warung serving home-style nasi campur at lunch. Semi-indoor with street views; open roughly 10am–5pm, closed Sundays.
best_for: home-style Javanese nasi campur; a midday lunch; vegetarians (plentiful veg options); travellers near Padang Linjong or Echo Beach wanting an unfussy local plate
not_for: dinner or Sunday diners (lunch-only, closed Sundays); large groups wanting lots of table space

name: Warung Varuna
why_its_here: Buffet-style Indonesian warung with 30-plus dishes in a glass case; you build a plate of rice, proteins and vegetables at low prices. Open daily 8am–10pm.
best_for: budget eaters near Batu Bolong beach; vegetarians and mixed groups who want to see and pick dishes; big-plate value seekers
not_for: diners who want food cooked hot-to-order rather than from a display

name: Warung Yess
why_its_here: A long-running Pererenan nasi campur warung with indoor and garden seating, known locally for its sambal matah. You pick from a daily fresh display to build a mixed-rice plate.
best_for: nasi campur and sambal matah lovers; a sit-down garden lunch; Pererenan-side stays; groups wanting greenery over a roadside stall
not_for: diners after Western dishes or a bar/nightlife setting

name: Watercress Berawa
where: Opposite Bali Equestrian Centre, Berawa, Tibubeneng, Kuta Utara, Badung, Bali, Indonesia
why_its_here: Watercress Berawa is an all-day café in Tibubeneng serving breakfast, brunch and international dishes.
best_for: Travellers choosing an easy breakfast or brunch in Berawa.

name: Wild Vegan
where: Jl. Sugriwa No.16, Ubud, Gianyar 80571
why_its_here: A 100% vegan restaurant with medicinal-plant and whole-food positioning in central Ubud.
best_for: Vegan and wellness-focused travellers.
not_for: Anyone looking for meat or alcohol-led dining.

name: Zahra Spa Nusa Dua
why_its_here: Spa in Nusa Dua. The published list covers Neck & Shoulder, Balinese Massage and Aromatherapy. Balinese Massage is 375K IDR. Booking is on the venue's own site.
best_for: Neck & shoulder booked the same day.

name: Zando Fight Camp Uluwatu
why_its_here: Muay Thai gym in Ungasan. Group and private sessions, technique for beginners through advanced, pad work and conditioning. A drop-in is 150,000 IDR and a month 1,600,000.
best_for: Muay Thai with hands-on pad work
not_for: A Sunday session - the gym is closed
